kjv: the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron
mine: Yahweh who appointed Moses and Aaron
note: Hebrew 'asah ("made, appointed") here means Yahweh installed them in office; "advanced" (raised to a position) now suggests promotion or progress.

kjv: then shall both ye (Israel) and also the king ... continue following the LORD
mine: and if both you (Israel) and the king ... follow Yahweh your God, well and good
note: The Hebrew conditional sentence lacks a clear apodosis; the final clause (vihyitem ... 'achar YHWH) can be read as the result (KJV) or as part of the condition with the consequence ("it will be well") left unstated.

kjv: against you (Israel), as it was against your fathers
mine: against you (Israel) and against your fathers
note: MT reads bakhem uva'avotekhem, "against you and against your fathers"; the KJV smooths it to a comparison, while the Septuagint reads "and against your king".
